statements.lede: Quantum Africa is building the people, institutions and partnerships that will shape Africa’s role in the quantum era. Through education, research, talent development and global collaboration.
We equip African students, educators and researchers with the knowledge, skills and opportunities to shape the quantum future.
We connect African talent and institutions with education, research and global opportunities in quantum technology.
Building accessible learning pathways and strengthening the talent, skills and institutions needed for Africa to thrive in the quantum era.

highlight.title: Quantum Machine Learning For Africa - Deep Learning Indaba, Nigeria
highlight.summary: Our mission is to create real on-the-ground impact by building opportunities and pathways for the next generation of African quantum talent, we proudly delivered the 2nd 𝐐𝐮𝐚𝐧𝐭𝐮𝐦 𝐌𝐚𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐞 𝐋𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐀𝐟𝐫𝐢𝐜𝐚 (𝐐𝐌𝐋𝟒𝐀𝐟𝐫𝐢𝐜𝐚) Workshop at Deep Learning Indaba 2026 at Pan-Atlantic University (PAU) in Lagos, bringing together participants from more than 40 nationalities across Africa 🇳🇬 .

about.story:
Quantum Africa was created from a simple conviction: Africa must have the knowledge, talent and capacity to participate in and help shape the quantum future.

What began as an initiative to connect African students, researchers and quantum enthusiasts has grown into a pan-African organization bringing together communities, universities, researchers and international partners. Through our chapters, educational programmes, research initiatives, workshops, webinars and collaborations, we are building pathways for African talent to learn, connect, conduct research and access opportunities in quantum technology.

Our journey is still at its beginning. Our ambition is to build a lasting continental ecosystem where quantum education and research are accessible, African institutions are strengthened, and African talent is connected to the global quantum community.
about.mission: To build Africa’s capacity in quantum science and technology by expanding access to quality education, strengthening research and innovation, developing the next generation of quantum leaders and workforce, and connecting African talent and institutions with the global quantum ecosystem.
about.vision:
An Africa with the knowledge, talent, institutions and networks to actively shape the global quantum future.

We envision a continent where students can access world-class quantum education, researchers can collaborate across borders and internationally, universities can develop strong quantum programmes, and talented Africans can pursue meaningful careers and research opportunities in quantum technology.
about.philosophy:
We believe that access is the first step, but capacity is the goal.

Quantum Africa is not built simply to introduce people to quantum technology. We aim to create the conditions for people to learn, practice, research, collaborate, innovate and lead.

Our approach is therefore built around a continuous pathway:

Discover → Learn → Build → Research → Connect → Lead

We believe Africa's quantum future should be built by African talent, strengthened through global collaboration, and translated into lasting capacity across the continent.
